definition_en: A habit or tradition that is common to a group of people.
example_en: It is a local custom to exchange gifts during the spring festival.
example_uz: Bahorgi bayramda sovg‘a almashish mahalliy an’anadir.

definition_en: Nearly, but not completely or exactly.
example_en: I have almost finished my homework before the sun goes down.
example_uz: Quyosh botguncha uy vazifamni deyarli tugatib qo‘ydim.

definition_en: The past tense of take, meaning to move or carry something somewhere.
example_en: He took his umbrella because he thought it might rain later today.
example_uz: U soyabonini oldi, chunki bugun yomg‘ir yog‘ishi mumkin deb o‘yladi.

definition_en: To be in a particular place or position.
example_en: The hotel is located right in the center of the city.
example_uz: Mehmonxona shahar markazida joylashgan.

definition_en: Having or involving many parts or happening many times.
example_en: She had to complete multiple tasks before the end of the day.
example_uz: U kun oxirigacha bir nechta vazifani bajarishi kerak edi.

definition_en: Coming from or relating to the continent of Asia.
example_en: He enjoys eating delicious Asian food at the local restaurant.
example_uz: U mahalliy restoranda mazali osiyo taomlarini yeyishni yoqtiradi.

definition_en: The process of giving things to a large number of people.
example_en: The charity is responsible for the distribution of food to the poor.
example_uz: Xayriya tashkiloti kambag'allarga oziq-ovqat tarqatish uchun mas'uldir.

definition_en: A person whose job is to correct or improve pieces of writing.
example_en: The editor corrected all the mistakes in my latest article draft.
example_uz: Muharrir mening oxirgi maqolam qoralamasidagi barcha xatolarni tuzatdi.

definition_en: A small hotel, usually in the countryside, providing food and rooms.
example_en: We stayed at a cozy village inn during our holiday trip.
example_uz: Dam olish sayohatimiz davomida qishloq mehmonxonasida qoldik.

definition_en: Related to the business of manufacturing products in factories.
example_en: The region has seen significant industrial growth over the last decade.
example_uz: Hudud oxirgi o'n yillikda sezilarli sanoat o'sishiga guvoh bo'ldi.

definition_en: The person or thing that makes something happen.
example_en: The heavy rain was the cause of the delay in our flight.
example_uz: Kuchli yomg'ir parvozdagi kechikishning sababi edi.

definition_en: A short piece of music with words that you sing.
example_en: Thomas listened to his favorite song on the radio yesterday.
example_uz: Tomas kecha radioda o'zining sevimli qo'shig'ini eshitdi.

definition_en: To give all your attention or effort to a particular thing.
example_en: You need to focus on your studies to get a good grade.
example_uz: Yaxshi baho olish uchun o'qishga diqqatingizni qaratishingiz kerak.

definition_en: To move downwards towards the ground from a higher position.
example_en: Be careful not to fall on the wet floor this morning.
example_uz: Bugun ertalab ho'l polga yiqilib tushmaslik uchun ehtiyot bo'ling.

definition_en: Relating to women or animals that can produce eggs.
example_en: The female bird is sitting on the nest in the tree.
example_uz: Urg'ochi qush daraxtdagi uyada o'tiribdi.

definition_en: The methods of sending information, like telephone or internet networks.
example_en: Modern communications allow us to talk to people across the world.
example_uz: Zamonaviy aloqa vositalari dunyoning narigi chekkasidagi odamlar bilan gaplashish imkonini beradi.

definition_en: To achieve first place or victory in a game or competition.
example_en: Our team hopes to win the football match later today.
example_uz: Bizning jamoa bugun futbol o'yinida g'alaba qozonishga umid qilmoqda.

definition_en: Connected with something else in your mind or in reality.
example_en: Smoking is often associated with many serious health problems.
example_uz: Chekish ko'pincha ko'plab jiddiy sog'liq muammolari bilan bog'liq.

definition_en: A serious illness where cells in the body grow in an uncontrolled way.
example_en: Early diagnosis is very important for the treatment of cancer.
example_uz: Erta tashxis saratonni davolash uchun juda muhimdir.

definition_en: A fact or situation that explains why something happens or why someone does something.
example_en: The main reason for his success is hard work and dedication.
example_uz: Uning muvaffaqiyatining asosiy sababi mehnatsevarlik va fidoyilikdir.

definition_en: A piece of equipment used to perform a specific job or task.
example_en: A screwdriver is a tool that no household should be without.
example_uz: Otvertka har bir xonadonda bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan asbobdir.

definition_en: The season of the year between winter and summer when plants begin to grow.
example_en: Flowers start to bloom everywhere during the beautiful spring season.
example_uz: Go'zal bahor faslida hamma joyda gullar ochila boshlaydi.

definition_en: The base that supports a building or the basic ideas an organization is built upon.
example_en: Education provides a strong foundation for a successful future career.
example_uz: Ta'lim muvaffaqiyatli kelajak karyerasi uchun mustahkam poydevor yaratadi.

definition_en: The sound produced by people when they speak or sing.
example_en: She has a very soft and pleasant voice when she sings.
example_uz: Qo'shiq aytganda uning ovozi juda mayin va yoqimli chiqadi.

definition_en: Behaving in a kind and pleasant way towards other people.
example_en: The local people are very friendly towards tourists visiting the city.
example_uz: Mahalliy aholi shaharga tashrif buyurgan sayyohlarga juda do'stona munosabatda.

definition_en: The process of sharing information or messages with other people.
example_en: Effective communication is essential for a healthy working relationship.
example_uz: Samarali muloqot sog'lom ish munosabatlari uchun juda muhimdir.

definition_en: The reason why something is done or why something exists.
example_en: The main purpose of this meeting is to discuss the new project.
example_uz: Bu uchrashuvning asosiy maqsadi yangi loyihani muhokama qilishdir.

definition_en: Every person in a group.
example_en: Everyone in the classroom was listening to the teacher carefully.
example_uz: Sinfdagi hamma o'qituvchini diqqat bilan eshitayotgan edi.

definition_en: Having the color of wood, earth, or coffee.
example_en: She has beautiful brown eyes and dark wavy hair.
example_uz: Uning chiroyli jigarrang ko'zlari va to'q jingalak sochlari bor.

definition_en: Connected with the body rather than the mind.
example_en: Regular physical exercise is important for keeping your heart healthy.
example_uz: Yurak sog'lig'ini saqlash uchun muntazam jismoniy mashqlar muhimdir.

definition_en: Currently working or being used.
example_en: Safety goggles must be worn when using operating machinery.
example_uz: Ishlayotgan texnikadan foydalanganda xavfsizlik ko'zoynagi taqilishi kerak.

definition_en: To take action or solve a problem regarding someone or something.
example_en: I need to deal with these urgent emails before I leave.
example_uz: Ketishdan oldin ushbu shoshilinch xatlar bilan shug'ullanishim kerak.

definition_en: To have something in your hands or arms.
example_en: Can you hold my bag while I open the door?
example_uz: Eshikni ochgunimcha sumkamni ushlab tura olasizmi?

definition_en: A person who makes objects by heating and hammering metal.
example_en: The local smith made a new iron gate for the garden.
example_uz: Mahalliy temirchi bog' uchun yangi temir darvoza yasadi.

definition_en: To tell someone that you are pleased about something they did for you.
example_en: I want to thank you for helping me with my homework today.
example_uz: Bugun uy vazifamni bajarishga yordam berganingiz uchun sizga tashakkur aytmoqchiman.

definition_en: Not in danger or not likely to cause harm.
example_en: It is safe to walk in this park during the daytime.
example_uz: Kunduzi bu bog'da sayr qilish xavfsizdir.

definition_en: A machine used to talk to someone who is in a different place.
example_en: Can I use your telephone to make a quick call home?
example_uz: Uyga tezda qo'ng'iroq qilish uchun telefoningizdan foydalansam bo'ladimi?

definition_en: A game or physical activity that people do for competition and exercise.
example_en: Football is the most popular sport in many countries around the world.
example_uz: Futbol dunyoning ko'plab mamlakatlarida eng ommabop sport turidir.

definition_en: Prepared for an action or an event that will happen soon.
example_en: Are you ready to go to school yet?
example_uz: Maktabga borishga tayyormisiz?

definition_en: To give food to a person or an animal.
example_en: Please remember to feed the cat before you leave the house.
example_uz: Uyga chiqib ketishingizdan oldin mushukni ovqatlantirishni unutmang.

definition_en: A country located in the southern part of North America.
example_en: Many tourists travel to Mexico to enjoy the beautiful sunny beaches.
example_uz: Ko'plab sayyohlar chiroyli quyoshli sohillardan bahramand bo'lish uchun Meksikaga sayohat qilishadi.

definition_en: Happening or doing something in a way that repeats at fixed times.
example_en: You should try to make a regular habit of exercising every morning.
example_uz: Siz har kuni ertalab mashq qilishni doimiy odatga aylantirishingiz kerak.

definition_en: The skill or process of planning and directing a path for a vehicle.
example_en: Modern cars have a built-in navigation system to help drivers find paths.
example_uz: Zamonaviy avtomobillarda haydovchilarga yo'l topishda yordam beradigan o'rnatilgan navigatsiya tizimi mavjud.

definition_en: The way a business or organization manages its daily work and systems.
example_en: She manages daily operations to ensure the company runs very smoothly.
example_uz: U kompaniyaning muammosiz ishlashini ta'minlash uchun kundalik operatsiyalarni boshqaradi.

definition_en: Used to say that something happens because of the fact just mentioned.
example_en: It was raining heavily and therefore we decided to stay at home.
example_uz: Kuchli yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi, shu sababli biz uyda qolishga qaror qildik.

definition_en: Used to emphasize that something is easy or basic to understand.
example_en: The answer is simply that we need to work much harder together.
example_uz: Javob shunchaki shundan iboratki, biz birgalikda yanada ko'proq ishlashimiz kerak.

definition_en: A person who believes in the teachings of Jesus Christ.
example_en: Many Christian people celebrate Christmas with their family and close friends.
example_uz: Ko'pgina xristianlar Rojdestvoni oilasi va yaqin do'stlari bilan nishonlaydilar.

definition_en: A series of regular visits made by a person to different places.
example_en: The doctor performs his daily round to check on all his patients.
example_uz: Shifokor barcha bemorlarini tekshirish uchun kundalik davrasini o'tkazadi.

definition_en: The thing or person that you like more than all others.
example_en: My favorite movie is the one we watched last night together.
example_uz: Mening sevimli filmi kecha birga ko'rganimizdir.

definition_en: A person who has power or authority over people or things.
example_en: The dog always listens to the commands of its kind master.
example_uz: It har doim o'zining mehribon xo'jayinining buyruqlariga quloq soladi.

definition_en: A low area of land between hills or mountains, often with a river.
example_en: A beautiful river flows through the green valley near our town.
example_uz: Shahrimiz yaqinidagi yashil vodiy orqali go'zal daryo oqib o'tadi.

definition_en: Not long ago or at a short time in the past.
example_en: I have recently started learning English to improve my career prospects.
example_uz: Karyera imkoniyatlarimni yaxshilash uchun yaqinda ingliz tilini o'rganishni boshladim.

definition_en: Used to mean that something is very likely to be true.
example_en: It will probably rain later this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
example_uz: Tushdan keyin ehtimol yomg'ir yog'adi, shuning uchun soyabon oling.

definition_en: To have made something by putting materials or parts together.
example_en: They built a new school in our village last summer season.
example_uz: O'tgan yozda qishlog'imizda yangi maktab qurishdi.

definition_en: The act of making information available to the public in printed form.
example_en: The professor has several important publications regarding climate change in his field.
example_uz: Professorning o'z sohasida iqlim o'zgarishiga oid bir nechta muhim nashrlari bor.

definition_en: The red liquid that flows through the bodies of people and animals.
example_en: Blood started to spurt out of his hand due to the wound.
example_uz: Jarohat tufayli uning qo'lidan qon oqib keta boshladi.

definition_en: To divide something into pieces or make an opening using a sharp tool.
example_en: Please use a sharp knife to cut the bread for breakfast.
example_uz: Iltimos nonushtaga non kesish uchun o'tkir pichoqdan foydalaning.

definition_en: Existing or happening in all parts of the world.
example_en: English is spoken worldwide by millions of people every single day.
example_uz: Ingliz tili har kuni millionlab odamlar tomonidan butun dunyo bo'ylab so'zlashiladi.

definition_en: A company or person that prepares and prints books or magazines.
example_en: The author is looking for a new publisher for her second novel.
example_uz: Muallif o'zining ikkinchi romani uchun yangi nashriyotchi izlamoqda.

definition_en: A space or passage inside the entrance of a building.
example_en: Please leave your wet coat in the hall before coming inside.
example_uz: Iltimos ichkariga kirishdan oldin ho'l paltoingizni dahlizda qoldiring.

definition_en: Greater in size or amount than something else.
example_en: We need a larger room to hold the conference for our team.
example_uz: Jamoamiz uchun konferensiya o'tkazishga kattaroq xona kerak.

definition_en: Opposed to or against a specific idea, person, or system.
example_en: The group held a protest to show they were anti war.
example_uz: Guruh urushga qarshi ekanliklarini ko'rsatish uchun norozilik namoyishi o'tkazdi.

definition_en: The first part of a book or presentation that describes the main subject.
example_en: I read the introduction of the book to understand the main ideas.
example_uz: Asosiy g'oyalarni tushunish uchun kitobning kirish qismini o'qidim.

definition_en: A formal ceremony where two people get married to each other.
example_en: We are very excited to attend our friend's wedding next Saturday evening.
example_uz: Kelasi shanba oqshomida do'stimizning to'yiga borishdan juda xursandmiz.

definition_en: Qualities or features that belong to a specific person or thing.
example_en: These chemical properties make the material safe to use at home.
example_uz: Bu kimyoviy xususiyatlar materialdan uyda foydalanishni xavfsiz qiladi.

definition_en: The solid surface of the earth that we walk on every day.
example_en: The heavy rain made the ground very soft and difficult to walk.
example_uz: Kuchli yomg'ir yerni juda yumshoq qilib qo'ydi va yurish qiyinlashdi.

definition_en: A short summary that gives the main facts about a larger subject.
example_en: The manager gave a quick overview of the project to the team.
example_uz: Menejer jamoaga loyiha haqida qisqacha umumiy ma'lumot berdi.

definition_en: A very large boat used for traveling across the ocean or deep seas.
example_en: The massive ship sailed slowly across the ocean towards the distant harbor.
example_uz: Ulkan kema okean bo'ylab uzoqdagi port tomon sekin suzdi.

definition_en: People who legally possess or have rights to something.
example_en: The house owners decided to paint the front door bright blue.
example_uz: Uy egalari kirish eshigini yorqin ko'k rangga bo'yashga qaror qilishdi.

definition_en: An illness that affects a person, animal, or plant.
example_en: The doctor explained how to prevent the spread of this disease.
example_uz: Shifokor ushbu kasallikning tarqalishini qanday oldini olishni tushuntirdi.

definition_en: Extremely good or of very high quality.
example_en: The students did an excellent job on their final history project.
example_uz: O'quvchilar o'zlarining yakuniy tarix loyihasida a'lo darajada ishlashdi.

definition_en: Involving money that must be given in exchange for a service.
example_en: She took a paid holiday after working hard for the company.
example_uz: U kompaniya uchun qattiq ishlaganidan so'ng haq to'lanadigan ta'tilga chiqdi.

definition_en: A country in southern Europe known for its history, art, and food.
example_en: We are planning a wonderful summer trip to visit sunny Italy.
example_uz: Biz quyoshli Italiyaga tashrif buyurish uchun ajoyib yozgi sayohatni rejalashtirmoqdamiz.

definition_en: Having no mistakes or faults; exactly right for a purpose.
example_en: The sunny weather was perfect for a picnic in the park.
example_uz: Quyoshli ob-havo bog'da piknik qilish uchun mukammal edi.

definition_en: A set of parts or tools needed for a specific task.
example_en: Every first aid kit should include bandages and cleaning supplies.
example_uz: Har bir birinchi yordam to'plami bintlar va tozalash vositalarini o'z ichiga olishi kerak.

definition_en: A typical example of something that has high quality and lasts long.
example_en: This novel is a classic example of twentieth-century English literature.
example_uz: Bu roman yigirmanchi asr ingliz adabiyotining klassik namunasidir.

definition_en: The main idea or fact that something is built on.
example_en: Scientific evidence should be the basis for every important medical decision.
example_uz: Ilmiy dalillar har bir muhim tibbiy qaror uchun asos bo'lishi kerak.

definition_en: To give an official order or to have control over a group.
example_en: The general will command his troops to move to the front line.
example_uz: General o'z qo'shinlariga oldingi chiziqqa o'tishni buyuradi.

definition_en: Large towns where many people live and work.
example_en: Many large cities around the world have problems with traffic jams.
example_uz: Dunyo bo'ylab ko'plab yirik shaharlarda tirbandlik bilan bog'liq muammolar mavjud.

definition_en: Clear, direct, and stated in a very specific way.
example_en: She gave me express instructions not to open the box until later.
example_uz: U menga qutini keyinroq ochmasligim haqida aniq ko'rsatma berdi.

definition_en: To officially give someone something like a prize or money.
example_en: The judges decided to award him the gold medal for his performance.
example_uz: Hakamlar uning ijrosi uchun unga oltin medalni topshirishga qaror qilishdi.

definition_en: The amount of space between two places or objects.
example_en: The distance between the two villages is only five kilometers.
example_uz: Ikki qishloq o'rtasidagi masofa atigi besh kilometr.

definition_en: The process of judging or deciding the value, quality, or importance of something.
example_en: The teacher gave an assessment of my progress during the first month.
example_uz: O'qituvchi birinchi oy davomida mening yutuqlarimni baholadi.

definition_en: More than what is usual, expected, or necessary.
example_en: I don't mind doing some extra work, as long as I get paid.
example_uz: Agar haqini to'lashsa, qo'shimcha ishlashga qarshiligim yo'q.

definition_en: More than usual; particularly or for a specific reason.
example_en: I love all kinds of fruits, especially fresh apples.
example_uz: Men barcha turdagi mevalarni, ayniqsa yangi uzilgan olmalarni yaxshi ko'raman.

definition_en: A point where two systems, subjects, or people meet and interact with each other.
example_en: The software has a simple user interface that is easy to navigate.
example_uz: Dastur foydalanish uchun qulay bo'lgan oddiy interfeysga ega.

definition_en: People who work together, play a game together, or are married.
example_en: We are looking for business partners to help expand our company abroad.
example_uz: Kompaniyamizni xorijda kengaytirish uchun biznes sheriklar qidiryapmiz.

definition_en: A plan showing how much money you have and how you will spend it.
example_en: We need to plan our travel budget carefully before the summer vacation.
example_uz: Yozgi ta'til oldidan sayohat byudjetimizni ehtiyotkorlik bilan rejalashtirishimiz kerak.

definition_en: The largest amount or number allowed or possible.
example_en: The maximum speed for cars on this road is ninety kilometers per hour.
example_uz: Bu yo'lda avtomobillar uchun maksimal tezlik soatiga to'qson kilometr.

definition_en: The way in which a machine, process, or organization works.
example_en: The factory is now back in full operation after the maintenance work.
example_uz: Ta'mirlash ishlaridan so'ng zavod yana to'liq ish faoliyatiga qaytdi.

definition_en: Something that is present or being used right now.
example_en: We should improve the existing system rather than building a new one.
example_uz: Yangi tizim qurishdan ko'ra mavjud tizimni yaxshilashimiz kerak.

definition_en: To a moderate extent or degree; rather.
example_en: Mind your shoes, the basement is quite wet.
example_uz: Oyoq kiyimingizga qarang, yerto'la ancha nam.

definition_en: A very tall, strong, and athletic woman.
example_en: Although the evidence for real Amazons is thin, women athletes are often dubbed amazons.
example_uz: Haqiqiy amazonkalar haqidagi dalillar kam bo'lsa-da, ayol sportchilar ko'pincha amazonkalar deb ataladi.

definition_en: An alcoholic drink made from fermented grape juice.
example_en: Wine is usually stronger than beer.
example_uz: Vino odatda pivodan kuchliroq bo'ladi.

definition_en: To express your choice formally in an election or meeting.
example_en: Did you vote for your favorite candidate in the election last month?
example_uz: O'tgan oydagi saylovda o'zingiz yoqtirgan nomzodga ovoz berdingizmi?

definition_en: Moving towards the direction in front of you.
example_en: The bus driver told everyone standing up to move forward.
example_uz: Avtobus haydovchisi tik turganlarning hammasiga oldinga o'tishni aytdi.

definition_en: Modern tools and methods based on science for practical purposes.
example_en: New communication technologies have changed how we talk to each other.
example_uz: Yangi aloqa texnologiyalari bir-birimiz bilan muloqot qilish usulimizni o'zgartirdi.

definition_en: A person who possesses or has the right to something.
example_en: The police recovered the stolen car and returned it to its owner.
example_uz: Politsiya o'g'irlangan mashinani topib, egasiga qaytarib berdi.

definition_en: Without stopping or using any other person or thing in between.
example_en: You should speak to the manager directly about the mistake you made.
example_uz: Siz qilgan xatoingiz haqida menejer bilan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gaplashishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A business that makes products in large quantities to sell to others.
example_en: Always return any broken goods to the manufacturer for a full refund.
example_uz: Buzilgan mahsulotlarni har doim to'liq pulini qaytarib olish uchun ishlab chiqaruvchiga qaytaring.

definition_en: An instruction that tells you what you are allowed to do or not.
example_en: You have to follow the rules to play the game correctly and fairly.
example_uz: O'yinni to'g'ri va adolatli o'ynash uchun qoidalarga amal qilishingiz kerak.

definition_en: To take someone or something with you to the place where you are going.
example_en: Please bring a notebook and a pen to the meeting tomorrow morning.
example_uz: Iltimos ertaga ertalabki yig'ilishga daftar va ruchka olib keling.

definition_en: A complete list of items in a specific order, often with descriptions and prices.
example_en: I looked through the online catalog to find a new winter jacket.
example_uz: Yangi qishki kurtka topish uchun onlayn katalogga ko'z yugurtirdim.

definition_en: Carefully thought about and reflecting a serious opinion or judgment.
example_en: It is my considered opinion that we should invest in new technology.
example_uz: Yangi texnologiyaga sarmoya kiritishimiz kerak degan o'ylangan qarordaman.

definition_en: Past tense and past participle of tell, meaning to communicate information to someone.
example_en: She told her friend that she would arrive at the station soon.
example_uz: U do'stiga vokzalga tez orada yetib kelishini aytdi.

definition_en: A set of planned events or a broadcast on television or radio.
example_en: The music programme will feature several local bands playing traditional songs tonight.
example_uz: Musiqa dasturida bugun kechqurun an'anaviy qo'shiqlarni ijro etadigan mahalliy guruhlar qatnashadi.

definition_en: Ideas, advice, or information that you give to help a process or project.
example_en: We welcome your input on how to improve our current working environment.
example_uz: Ish muhitimizni yaxshilash bo'yicha takliflaringizni mamnuniyat bilan qabul qilamiz.

definition_en: The plural of foot, the parts of the body used for standing and walking.
example_en: After walking all day in the city, my feet were very sore.
example_uz: Kun bo'yi shaharda piyoda yurgandan keyin oyoqlarim juda og'ridi.

definition_en: A person who acts on behalf of another person or a company.
example_en: The travel agent helped us book a cheap flight to Tashkent.
example_uz: Sayohat agenti Toshkentga arzon aviachipta buyurtma qilishimizga yordam berdi.

definition_en: A container used to hold rubbish or waste until it is collected.
example_en: Please put your empty plastic bottle into the rubbish bin.
example_uz: Iltimos, bo‘sh plastik idishingizni axlat qutisiga tashlang.

definition_en: Having a higher rank or level of importance than other people in an organization.
example_en: She is a senior manager who makes all the important decisions.
example_uz: U barcha muhim qarorlarni qabul qiladigan yuqori martabali menejerdir.

definition_en: The job or profession of being a teacher in a school or college.
example_en: After finishing university, she decided to start a career in teaching.
example_uz: Universitetni tugatgandan so‘ng, u o‘qituvchilik kasbida faoliyat boshlashga qaror qildi.

definition_en: Impressive in size, beauty, or importance.
example_en: The hotel was very grand with marble floors and golden lights.
example_uz: Mehmonxona marmar pollar va oltin chiroqlar bilan juda ulug‘vor ko‘rinardi.

definition_en: A formal meeting in a court to decide if someone has broken the law.
example_en: The man was found not guilty after a long and difficult trial.
example_uz: Uzoq va qiyin sud jarayonidan so‘ng erkak aybsiz deb topildi.

definition_en: The amount of money that you must pay for a service or product.
example_en: There is no extra charge for delivery if you buy online.
example_uz: Agar internet orqali xarid qilsangiz, yetkazib berish uchun qo‘shimcha to‘lov yo‘q.

definition_en: As a substitute or alternative to someone or something else.
example_en: I did not have any coffee, so I drank tea instead.
example_uz: Menda qahva qolmagandi, shuning uchun o‘rniga choy ichdim.

definition_en: Relating to the country of Canada or its people.
example_en: My brother lives in Toronto and works for a Canadian company.
example_uz: Akam Torontoda yashaydi va Kanada kompaniyasida ishlaydi.

definition_en: Having a temperature that is low but not cold.
example_en: I like cool weather the most when I walk in the park.
example_uz: Bog'da sayr qilganda salqin ob-havoni juda yoqtiraman.

definition_en: Usual or expected; not different from what is typical.
example_en: It is normal to feel tired after a very long day.
example_uz: Uzoq kundan keyin charchoq his qilish normal holat.

definition_en: Past tense of write; to produce words on paper or a screen.
example_en: He wrote a long letter to his family last Sunday.
example_uz: U o'tgan yakshanba oilasiga uzun xat yozdi.

definition_en: Including everything or every part of something; whole.
example_en: They spent the entire afternoon cleaning their small house.
example_uz: Ular butun tushdan keyingi vaqtni kichik uylarini tozalashga sarflashdi.

definition_en: Providing knowledge or teaching something useful.
example_en: This museum offers many educational programs for local school children.
example_uz: Ushbu muzey mahalliy maktab o'quvchilari uchun ko'plab ta'limiy dasturlar taklif etadi.

definition_en: A hard, strong material like iron, gold, or silver.
example_en: The keys are made of a very strong type of metal.
example_uz: Kalitlar juda mustahkam metal turidan yasalgan.

definition_en: Thinking about the good qualities of a person or situation.
example_en: Try to keep a positive attitude even when things are difficult.
example_uz: Vaziyat qiyin bo'lsa ham ijobiy kayfiyatni saqlashga harakat qiling.

definition_en: The condition of being physically healthy and strong through exercise.
example_en: Regular exercise is important for maintaining good fitness and health.
example_uz: Muntazam jismoniy mashqlar fitness va sog'likni saqlash uchun muhimdir.

definition_en: A person from China or a language spoken in China.
example_en: I am learning Chinese because I want to travel to Beijing next year.
example_uz: Men xitoy tilini o'rganyapman chunki kelasi yili Pekinga bormoqchiman.

definition_en: The largest continent in the world, located to the east of Europe.
example_en: Many different cultures and traditions can be found throughout the continent of Asia.
example_uz: Osiyo qit'asi bo'ylab ko'plab turli madaniyatlar va an'analarni uchratish mumkin.

definition_en: A popular game where two teams try to kick a ball into a goal.
example_en: My friends and I play football at the park every Sunday morning.
example_uz: Do'stlarim va men har yakshanba tongda parkda futbol o'ynaymiz.

definition_en: The amount of goods or work produced by a person, machine, or factory.
example_en: The factory increased its daily output to meet the high market demand.
example_uz: Zavod bozor talabini qondirish uchun kundalik ishlab chiqarish hajmini oshirdi.

definition_en: An amount of money that is saved or made available for a specific purpose.
example_en: The company does not have enough funds to start the new project.
example_uz: Kompaniyada yangi loyihani boshlash uchun yetarli mablag' mavjud emas.

definition_en: Larger in size, number, importance, or degree than something else.
example_en: The city needs greater investment to improve its public transport system.
example_uz: Shaharga jamoat transporti tizimini yaxshilash uchun kattaroq sarmoya kerak.

definition_en: Probable; something that is expected to happen or be true.
example_en: It is highly likely that they will arrive before the meeting ends.
example_uz: Ular yig'ilish tugaguniga qadar yetib kelishlari ehtimoli juda yuqori.

definition_en: People who are paid to work for a person or a company.
example_en: The manager held a meeting to thank all the employees for their effort.
example_uz: Menejer barcha xodimlarga qilgan mehnatlari uchun minnatdorchilik bildirishga yig'ilish o'tkazdi.

definition_en: One of two or more things that you can choose between.
example_en: We have no other alternative but to accept the new job offer.
example_uz: Yangi ish taklifini qabul qilishdan boshqa muqobil tanlovimiz yo'q.

definition_en: Something that you must do or look after because it is your job or duty.
example_en: It is your responsibility to finish the project by next Friday afternoon.
example_uz: Loyiha ustida ishlashni kelasi juma tushdan keyingacha tugatish sizning mas'uliyatingiz.

definition_en: A firm decision to do or not to do something.
example_en: My New Year resolution is to start exercising every single morning regularly.
example_uz: Mening yangi yil qarorim — har kuni ertalab muntazam ravishda mashq qilishni boshlashdir.

definition_en: An informal term used to refer to a cup of coffee.
example_en: Let us stop at that small cafe for a fresh cup of java.
example_uz: Keling, yangi damlangan bir finjon qahva uchun o'sha kichik kafeda to'xtaymiz.

definition_en: To give the impression of being or doing something.
example_en: The weather seems much better today than it was yesterday morning.
example_uz: Ob-havo bugun kechagi tongga qaraganda ancha yaxshiroq ko'rinadi.

definition_en: A book, magazine, or newspaper that has been printed and is available for sale.
example_en: The company produces several popular scientific publications for students and university professors.
example_uz: Kompaniya talabalar va universitet professorlari uchun bir nechta mashhur ilmiy nashrlarni tayyorlaydi.

definition_en: To go past something or move from one place to another.
example_en: Please pass the salt to me during our dinner this evening.
example_uz: Iltimos, bugun kechki ovqat paytida tuzni menga uzatib yuboring.

definition_en: The way in which two or more people or groups behave toward each other.
example_en: The two countries are trying to improve their diplomatic relations this year.
example_uz: Ikki mamlakat bu yil o'zlarining diplomatik munosabatlarini yaxshilashga urinmoqda.

definition_en: A closed motor vehicle used for carrying goods or a small group of people.
example_en: The delivery man parked his van in front of the small shop.
example_uz: Yetkazib beruvchi furgonini kichik do'kon oldida to'xtatdi.

definition_en: To have something inside or be part of a whole.
example_en: This glass bottle contains fresh water from the mountain stream.
example_uz: Bu shisha idish tog' daryosidan olingan toza suvni o'z ichiga oladi.

definition_en: A period of time spent doing a particular organized activity.
example_en: We had a long training session to learn the new software system.
example_uz: Yangi dasturiy ta'minotni o'rganish uchun uzoq mashg'ulot o'tkazdik.

definition_en: The art or job of taking pictures using a camera.
example_en: She took a course in photography to improve her picture taking skills.
example_uz: U suratga olish mahoratini oshirish uchun fotografiya kursiga bordi.

definition_en: A country governed by elected representatives instead of a king or queen.
example_en: The people voted to change their country into a democratic republic.
example_uz: Xalq o'z mamlakatini demokratik respublikaga aylantirish uchun ovoz berdi.

definition_en: Money that you pay for professional services or for the right to do something.
example_en: Students must pay their tuition fees before the start of the term.
example_uz: Talabalar o'qish boshlanishidan oldin o'qish to'lovlarini to'lashlari kerak.

definition_en: A period of time when you do not work or go to school for rest.
example_en: We are planning to go on a summer vacation to the beach.
example_uz: Biz yozgi ta'tilda dengiz sohiliga borishni rejalashtiryapmiz.

definition_en: The act of helping someone to finish a task or complete a job.
example_en: Financial assistance is available for students from families with very low income.
example_uz: Kam ta'minlangan oilalardan bo'lgan talabalar uchun moliyaviy yordam mavjud.

definition_en: The soft outer layer of the body that covers a person or an animal.
example_en: He is so disgusting that he really makes my skin crawl today.
example_uz: U shunchalik yoqimsizki, bugun rostdan ham etimni jimirlatadi.

definition_en: Images or designs produced on a computer screen for games or other programs.
example_en: This new video game has much better graphics than the previous version.
example_uz: Bu yangi video o'yin avvalgi versiyasiga qaraganda ancha yaxshi grafikaga ega.

definition_en: A letter or number that shows how well a student performed on a test.
example_en: He studied very hard and got a good grade on the test.
example_uz: U juda qattiq o'qidi va testdan yaxshi baho oldi.

definition_en: Showing a desire for peace and avoiding violence or conflict.
example_en: The country maintained a pacific policy toward its neighboring states for years.
example_uz: Mamlakat yillar davomida qo‘shni davlatlarga nisbatan tinch siyosat yuritdi.

definition_en: To make a short, sharp, explosive sound, often causing something to burst.
example_en: The young boy decided to pop the balloon with a sharp needle.
example_uz: Yosh bola sharni o‘tkir igna bilan yorishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: A device or program that removes unwanted things from a liquid, gas, or information.
example_en: You should change the water filter in the machine every six months.
example_uz: Siz mashinadagi suv filtrini har olti oyda almashtirib turishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A machine like a car or bus used to carry people or goods.
example_en: Please park your vehicle in the designated area near the main entrance.
example_uz: Iltimos, transport vositangizni asosiy kirish eshigi yaqinidagi belgilangan joyga qo‘ying.

definition_en: Measuring more from one end to the other than something else.
example_en: The meeting lasted much longer than we had originally planned last week.
example_uz: Yig‘ilish o‘tgan hafta rejalashtirganimizdan ancha uzoqroq davom etdi.

definition_en: To spend time thinking about a possibility or making a decision.
example_en: We are starting to consider moving to a new house next year.
example_uz: Biz kelasi yili yangi uyga ko‘chib o‘tish haqida o‘ylay boshlayapmiz.

definition_en: Situated in or facing the direction of the north.
example_en: The northern part of the country is much colder during the winter.
example_uz: Mamlakatning shimoliy qismi qishda ancha sovuqroq bo‘ladi.

definition_en: At or to the back part of someone or something.
example_en: The children were hiding behind the wall during the game.
example_uz: Bolalar o'yin davomida devor orqasida yashirinishgan edi.

definition_en: A small group of people brought together to discuss or decide something.
example_en: The panel of experts will discuss the new climate change policy.
example_uz: Ekspertlar hay'ati yangi iqlim o'zgarishi siyosatini muhokama qiladi.

definition_en: A competitive sporting event where two teams or individuals play against each other.
example_en: My local football team is playing in a match tomorrow evening.
example_uz: Mahalliy futbol jamoam ertaga kechqurun o'yinda ishtirok etadi.

definition_en: Suggested as a plan or idea but not yet officially put into effect.
example_en: We reviewed the proposed changes to the company rules this morning.
example_uz: Biz bugun ertalab kompaniya qoidalariga kiritilgan takliflarni ko'rib chiqdik.

definition_en: The original or standard settings that exist before a user changes anything.
example_en: You can change the default font size in the application settings.
example_uz: Ilova sozlamalarida standart shrift hajmini o'zgartirishingiz mumkin.

definition_en: Existing, happening, or done outside rather than inside a building.
example_en: They enjoyed an outdoor meal in the park on a sunny day.
example_uz: Ular quyoshli kunda bog'da ochiq havoda ovqatlanishdan zavq olishdi.

definition_en: Extending far down from the top surface or far inward from an outer edge.
example_en: The lake is very deep so you should be careful when swimming.
example_uz: Ko'l juda chuqur shuning uchun cho'milganda ehtiyot bo'lishingiz kerak.

definition_en: Used to say what will happen if something else does not occur or happen.
example_en: You must study hard, otherwise you will not pass the difficult exam.
example_uz: Qattiq o'qishingiz kerak aks holda qiyin imtihondan o'ta olmaysiz.

definition_en: A period of time when you are relaxing or sleeping to get energy back.
example_en: I need to get some rest after working in the office all day.
example_uz: Kun bo'yi ofisda ishlaganimdan keyin biroz dam olishim kerak.

definition_en: A substance found in food like meat, eggs, and beans that helps your body grow.
example_en: Athletes eat a lot of protein to build strong muscles after their training.
example_uz: Sportchilar mashg'ulotdan keyin kuchli mushaklar qurish uchun ko'p oqsil iste'mol qilishadi.

definition_en: A living thing that grows in the earth and has leaves and roots.
example_en: She waters the green plant in her room every single morning for growth.
example_uz: U har kuni ertalab xonasidagi yashil o'simlikni o'sishi uchun sug'oradi.

definition_en: To touch someone or something with force, often using your hand or an object.
example_en: The tennis player hit the ball very hard across the wide net today.
example_uz: Tennischi bugun to'pni keng to'r ustidan juda qattiq urdi.

definition_en: The movement of people or goods from one place to another using vehicles.
example_en: Public transportation is very cheap and efficient in many large modern cities.
example_uz: Jamoat transporti ko'plab yirik zamonaviy shaharlarda juda arzon va samarali.

definition_en: An area of water that has been built for people to swim in.
example_en: We like to go to the local pool to swim during the summer.
example_uz: Biz yozda suzish uchun mahalliy hovuzga borishni yaxshi ko'ramiz.

definition_en: Something that is very small or miniature in size.
example_en: She decided to buy a mini version of the popular camera.
example_uz: U mashhur kameraning mini versiyasini sotib olishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: The activities involved in managing a country or a government.
example_en: He has been very active in local politics for ten years.
example_uz: U o'n yil davomida mahalliy siyosatda juda faol bo'lib kelmoqda.

definition_en: A person you work or play with as a team.
example_en: My business partner and I are opening a new shop tomorrow.
example_uz: Biznes sherigim va men ertaga yangi do'kon ochyapmiz.

definition_en: A formal statement that says you are not responsible for something.
example_en: The website includes a disclaimer about the accuracy of information.
example_uz: Veb-saytda ma'lumotlarning aniqligi haqida rad etish bayonoti mavjud.

definition_en: Social events where people enjoy food, drinks, and music together.
example_en: We usually go to parties with our friends on weekends.
example_uz: Biz odatda dam olish kunlari do'stlarimiz bilan ziyofatlarga boramiz.

definition_en: The state of being a member of a group or organization.
example_en: You need a valid membership to access the gym equipment.
example_uz: Sport zali jihozlaridan foydalanish uchun sizda amal qiluvchi a'zolik bo'lishi kerak.

definition_en: An important job or task that someone is sent to do.
example_en: Their main mission is to provide clean water to everyone.
example_uz: Ularning asosiy missiyasi barchani toza suv bilan ta'minlashdir.

definition_en: A long, thin piece of thread used for tying or holding things.
example_en: Please use a piece of string to tie the parcel together.
example_uz: Iltimos, posilkani bog'lash uchun bir parcha ipdan foydalaning.

definition_en: One of the five natural powers to perceive the physical world like sight or smell.
example_en: Humans use the sense of sight to understand the world around them.
example_uz: Insonlar atrof-muhitni tushunish uchun ko‘rish qobiliyatidan foydalanadilar.

definition_en: Made smaller or less extreme changes to something to improve it.
example_en: The modified engine is much faster than the original version was.
example_uz: O‘zgartirilgan dvigatel dastlabki versiyadan ancha tezroq ishlaydi.

definition_en: To put your clothes and things into a bag before a trip.
example_en: I need to pack my suitcase before we leave for the airport.
example_uz: Aeroportga jo‘nashdan oldin chamadonimni joylab olishim kerak.

definition_en: One part of a process that happens in several steps.
example_en: We are currently in the final stage of the project development.
example_uz: Biz hozirda loyihani ishlab chiqishning yakuniy bosqichidamiz.

definition_en: Located inside something rather than on the outside.
example_en: The building suffered internal damage after the storm last night.
example_uz: O‘tgan tungi bo‘rondan keyin bino ichki qismidan zarar ko‘rdi.

definition_en: Products that are made to be sold.
example_en: The shop sells a wide range of goods from around the world.
example_uz: Do‘kon dunyo bo‘ylab turli xil tovarlarni sotadi.

definition_en: Existing as a result of being brought into life.
example_en: She was born in a small village near the mountains.
example_uz: U tog‘lar yaqinidagi kichik bir qishloqda tug‘ilgan.

definition_en: Except if something happens or is the case.
example_en: You cannot pass the exam unless you study very hard.
example_uz: Agar qattiq o‘qimasangiz, imtihondan o‘ta olmaysiz.

definition_en: Having many small parts or including a lot of information.
example_en: The manager gave us a very detailed report about the new project.
example_uz: Menejer bizga yangi loyiha haqida juda batafsil hisobot berdi.

definition_en: A competition to see who can travel a distance in the shortest time.
example_en: She decided to enter the bicycle race to test her physical strength.
example_uz: U jismoniy kuchini sinab ko'rish uchun velosiped poygasida qatnashishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: Having official permission or agreement for something to be done.
example_en: The committee finally approved the new plan for the city park development.
example_uz: Qo'mita shahar bog'ini rivojlantirish uchun yangi rejani nihoyat tasdiqladi.

definition_en: The education, experience, and family life of a person.
example_en: The successful candidate has a strong background in software engineering and design.
example_uz: Muvaffaqiyatli nomzod dasturiy ta'minot muhandisligi va dizayni bo'yicha kuchli tajribaga ega.

definition_en: A result or goal that you want to achieve within a specific time.
example_en: The company set a sales target to increase profits by ten percent annually.
example_uz: Kompaniya foydani har yili o'n foizga oshirish bo'yicha savdo maqsadini belgiladi.

definition_en: Used to say that something is not included in a group or statement.
example_en: Everyone was at the meeting except for the manager who was away.
example_uz: Uchrashuvda yo'qligi sababli menejerdan tashqari hamma ishtirok etdi.

definition_en: The work needed to keep a machine or building in good condition.
example_en: Regular maintenance of the car helps to prevent serious engine problems later.
example_uz: Mashinaga muntazam texnik xizmat ko'rsatish kelajakda jiddiy muammolarning oldini olishga yordam beradi.

definition_en: The physical or mental power that you need to do something.
example_en: She has the ability to speak three languages very fluently and correctly.
example_uz: U uchta tilda juda ravon va to'g'ri gapira olish qobiliyatiga ega.

definition_en: Used to say that something is possible but not certain.
example_en: Maybe we will go to the park if the weather stays nice.
example_uz: Agar ob-havo yaxshi tursa balki bog'ga borarmiz.

definition_en: To a fairly large degree, but not extremely.
example_en: The homework was pretty difficult, but I managed to finish it alone.
example_uz: Uyga vazifa ancha qiyin edi, lekin uni yolg'iz tugatishga erishdim.

definition_en: A name or symbol that a company uses on its products to show ownership.
example_en: The company protects its various trademarks to ensure no one copies products.
example_uz: Kompaniya o'zining turli savdo belgilarini hech kim mahsulotlarni nusxalamasligini ta'minlash uchun himoya qiladi.

definition_en: A medicine used to help people lose weight by reducing their hunger.
example_en: The doctor prescribed phentermine for a short period to aid weight loss.
example_uz: Shifokor vazn yo'qotishga yordam berish uchun qisqa muddatga fentermin buyurdi.

definition_en: A country located in southwestern Europe.
example_en: We are planning to visit the beautiful beaches of Spain this summer.
example_uz: Biz yozda Ispaniyaning go'zal plyajlariga borishni rejalashtiryapmiz.

definition_en: Situated in or facing the south direction.
example_en: The southern part of the country is much warmer than the north.
example_uz: Mamlakatning janubiy qismi shimolga qaraganda ancha issiqroq.

definition_en: Used when the person you are speaking to is the object of an action.
example_en: You should take care of yourself during this busy time of year.
example_uz: Yilning bu gavjum vaqtida o'zingizga e'tiborli bo'lishingiz kerak.

definition_en: The coldest season of the year, between autumn and spring.
example_en: It often snows in this city during the long winter months.
example_uz: Bu shaharda uzun qish oylarida tez-tez qor yog'adi.

definition_en: A device that provides electricity for things like phones, toys, and cars.
example_en: My phone died because the battery ran out of power today.
example_uz: Bugun batareya quvvati tugagani uchun telefonim o'chib qoldi.

definition_en: The period of time when someone is young, usually before becoming an adult.
example_en: He often talks about the many adventures he had in his youth.
example_uz: U yoshligida boshidan kechirgan ko'plab sarguzashtlari haqida tez-tez gapiradi.

definition_en: The force you apply when you push or press on something.
example_en: You need to apply constant pressure to the wound to stop bleeding.
example_uz: Qon ketishini to'xtatish uchun jarohatga doimiy bosim berish kerak.

definition_en: Gave a document or plan to someone for them to look at or approve.
example_en: I finally submitted my application for the new job this morning.
example_uz: Men bugun ertalab nihoyat yangi ish uchun arizamni topshirdim.

definition_en: A state of owing something, usually money, to another person or organization.
example_en: He had to work extra hours to pay off his student debt.
example_uz: U talabalik qarzini to'lash uchun qo'shimcha soatlab ishlashga majbur bo'ldi.

definition_en: Important words that identify the main topic of a text or document.
example_en: Searching with specific keywords helps you find information on the internet faster.
example_uz: Aniq kalit so'zlar bilan izlash internetdan ma'lumotni tezroq topishga yordam beradi.

definition_en: A machine used for watching programs that show images and sound.
example_en: We watched a very interesting documentary on the television last night.
example_uz: Kecha kechqurun televizorda juda qiziqarli hujjatli filmni tomosha qildik.

definition_en: To damage something so that it separates into pieces or stops working.
example_en: Be careful not to break the expensive vase on the table.
example_uz: Stoldagi qimmatbaho vazani sindirib qo'ymaslik uchun ehtiyot bo'ling.

definition_en: In every part of a place or during the whole period of time.
example_en: The museum was crowded with tourists throughout the entire summer.
example_uz: Muzey butun yoz davomida sayyohlar bilan gavjum bo'ldi.

definition_en: The hard material that trees are made of, used to build things.
example_en: This traditional chair is made from high quality oak wood.
example_uz: Bu an'anaviy stul yuqori sifatli eman yog'ochidan yasalgan.

definition_en: Used when the subject and the object of a sentence are the same thing.
example_en: The machine will turn itself off when the task is complete.
example_uz: Mashina vazifa bajarilganda o'z-o'zidan o'chadi.

definition_en: An amount of money that you pay for a service or for a privilege.
example_en: You have to pay a small late fee if you return books after today.
example_uz: Agar kitoblarni bugundan kech qaytarsangiz, ozgina kechikish to'lovi to'lashingiz kerak.

definition_en: A room where an artist, photographer, or musician works or creates their art.
example_en: The band spent the whole weekend in the studio recording their new album.
example_uz: Musiqa guruhi butun dam olish kunini yangi albomini yozib olish uchun studiyada o'tkazdi.

definition_en: A person who is reading a book, magazine, or other written material.
example_en: She is an enthusiastic reader who finishes at least one book every week.
example_uz: U har hafta kamida bitta kitob o'qiydigan g'ayratli kitobxon.

definition_en: A piece of equipment or a machine made for a particular useful purpose.
example_en: This small electronic device helps me translate languages while I am traveling abroad.
example_uz: Bu kichik elektron qurilma chet elda sayohat qilayotganimda tillarni tarjima qilishga yordam beradi.

definition_en: Money that you pay regularly to live in a house or use a property.
example_en: The monthly rent for this apartment is quite expensive for the city center.
example_uz: Bu kvartiraning oylik ijara haqi shahar markazi uchun ancha qimmat.

definition_en: Far away from other places or people in distance or in time.
example_en: Many people enjoy living in remote areas to escape the noise of the city.
example_uz: Ko'p odamlar shahar shovqinidan qochish uchun uzoq hududlarda yashashni yoqtirishadi.

definition_en: Having very little or no light in a place.
example_en: It is dangerous to walk alone in the park when it gets dark outside.
example_uz: Tashqarida qorong'i tushganda bog'da yolg'iz yurish xavfli.

definition_en: Coming from outside of a person, organization, or object.
example_en: The company decided to hire an external consultant to solve their management problems.
example_uz: Kompaniya menejment muammolarini hal qilish uchun tashqi maslahatchi yollashga qaror qildi.

definition_en: Relating to or concerning a particular subject or topic.
example_en: I am writing to you regarding the position you advertised yesterday.
example_uz: Men sizga kecha e'lon qilgan lavozimingiz haqida yozmoqdaman.

definition_en: To get happiness or satisfaction from doing or experiencing something.
example_en: I really enjoy dancing with my friends at the weekend.
example_uz: Men dam olish kunlari do'stlarim bilan raqsga tushishdan juda zavqlanaman.

definition_en: To take something away from the place where it is currently.
example_en: Please remove your shoes before entering the house to keep it clean.
example_uz: Uyni toza saqlash uchun iltimos uyga kirishdan oldin poyabzalingizni yeching.

definition_en: Help or support given to someone who needs it.
example_en: The government sent emergency aid to the people after the earthquake.
example_uz: Hukumat zilziladan keyin odamlarga favqulodda yordam yubordi.

definition_en: The outside layer or top part of an object or liquid.
example_en: The table has a smooth surface that is easy to wipe clean.
example_uz: Stolning tozalash oson bo'lgan silliq yuzasi bor.

definition_en: The smallest possible amount or lowest limit that is allowed.
example_en: We need a minimum of three staff members to start the meeting.
example_uz: Majlisni boshlash uchun bizga kamida uchta xodim kerak.

definition_en: To organize an event and look after the guests or visitors.
example_en: They will host a dinner party for their new neighbors next week.
example_uz: Ular kelasi hafta yangi qo'shnilari uchun kechki ovqat ziyofatini uyushtirishadi.

definition_en: A collection of several different things of the same general type.
example_en: The shop offers a wide variety of fresh fruit and vegetables.
example_uz: Do'kon yangi meva va sabzavotlarning keng turini taklif etadi.

definition_en: A unique identification number assigned to a published book for tracking purposes.
example_en: You can find the book by searching its ISBN online.
example_uz: Kitobni onlayn qidirish orqali uning ISBN raqamini topishingiz mumkin.

definition_en: A small bird that flies quickly and catches insects in the air.
example_en: We saw a martin flying swiftly over the quiet river.
example_uz: Biz tinch daryo ustida tez uchayotgan qaldirg'ochni ko'rdik.

definition_en: A book that gives instructions on how to use a machine or tool.
example_en: Read the instruction manual carefully before you start using the device.
example_uz: Qurilmadan foydalanishni boshlashdan oldin yo'riqnomani diqqat bilan o'qing.

definition_en: A solid piece of hard material with flat surfaces on all sides.
example_en: He used a heavy block of wood to keep the door open.
example_uz: U eshikni ochiq holda ushlab turish uchun og'ir yog'och blokdan foydalandi.

definition_en: To fix something that is broken or not working correctly.
example_en: It is cheaper to repair the old bike than to buy new.
example_uz: Eski velosipedni ta'mirlash yangisini sotib olishdan ko'ra arzonroq.

definition_en: Relating to ordinary people or being polite and behaving in a formal way.
example_en: It is important to keep a civil tone during a professional debate.
example_uz: Professional bahs paytida madaniyatli ohangni saqlash juda muhim.

definition_en: A very strong metal made from iron that is used for building things.
example_en: Modern buildings are often constructed using a frame of strong steel.
example_uz: Zamonaviy binolar ko'pincha mustahkam po'lat karkas yordamida quriladi.

definition_en: Not able to be changed or moved.
example_en: I work fixed hours for a fixed salary every single month.
example_uz: Men har oy belgilangan maosh uchun belgilangan soatlarda ishlayman.

definition_en: Not correct or not true.
example_en: Some of your answers were correct, and some were wrong.
example_uz: Javoblaringizning ba'zilari to'g'ri, ba'zilari esa noto'g'ri edi.

definition_en: The first part of something.
example_en: She read the beginning of the book before she went to sleep.
example_uz: U uxlashdan oldin kitobning boshlanishini o'qib chiqdi.

definition_en: To connect or link two people or things together in your mind.
example_en: Most people associate the color red with love and passion.
example_uz: Ko'p odamlar qizil rangni sevgi va ishtiyoq bilan bog'laydi.

definition_en: Happening after a long time or at the end.
example_en: The contest was long, but the team finally finished the race.
example_uz: Musobaqa uzoq davom etdi, ammo jamoa nihoyat poygani tugatdi.

definition_en: A computer that is designed to stay in one place on a desk.
example_en: My old desktop computer is much faster than my new laptop.
example_uz: Eski stol kompyuterim yangi noutbukimdan ancha tezroq.

definition_en: A warm piece of clothing made of knitted wool for the upper body.
example_en: She wore a thick wool jersey to keep warm in the winter.
example_uz: Qishda isinib yurish uchun u qalin jun sviter kiyib oldi.

definition_en: Having a lot of weight or body mass.
example_en: The fat cat slept comfortably on the sunny wooden floor.
example_uz: Semiz mushuk quyosh tushib turgan yog'och polda bemalol uxlar edi.

definition_en: In a way that is complete; nothing is missing.
example_en: I am fully aware of the risks involved in this project.
example_uz: Men ushbu loyihadagi xatarlardan to'liq xabardorman.

definition_en: Using or producing electricity to work.
example_en: We bought a new electric kettle to boil water for tea.
example_uz: Biz choy uchun suv qaynatish maqsadida yangi elektr choynak sotib oldik.

definition_en: A tool with a sharp, jagged edge used for cutting wood or metal.
example_en: He used a sharp saw to cut the thick wooden board.
example_uz: U qalin yog'och taxtani kesish uchun o'tkir arradan foydalandi.

definition_en: Tools or devices used for specialized work or making music.
example_en: The surgeon carefully cleaned all the medical instruments before the operation.
example_uz: Jarroh operatsiyadan oldin barcha tibbiy asboblarni ehtiyotkorlik bilan tozaladi.

definition_en: A person who has a position of authority in an organization or the police.
example_en: The police officer stopped the car to check the driver's license.
example_uz: Politsiya xodimi haydovchining guvohnomasini tekshirish uchun mashinani to'xtatdi.

definition_en: Not living anymore.
example_en: The old plant died because it did not get enough sunlight.
example_uz: Qari o'simlik yetarli quyosh nurini olmagani uchun qurib qoldi.

definition_en: Not identified or not known to many people.
example_en: The cause of the fire remains unknown to the local police.
example_uz: Yong'inning sababi mahalliy politsiyaga noma'lum bo'lib qolmoqda.

definition_en: Clearly and definitely stated or described.
example_en: Please deliver the goods within the specified time period.
example_uz: Iltimos, tovarlarni belgilangan muddat ichida yetkazib bering.

definition_en: A piece of equipment used to make your voice louder.
example_en: He stepped up to the mike to begin his speech.
example_uz: U nutqini boshlash uchun mikrofonga yaqinlashdi.

definition_en: Having a specific value or deserving of some action.
example_en: This old book is worth a lot of money now.
example_uz: Bu eski kitob hozir juda qimmat turadi.

definition_en: Having very little money or very few possessions.
example_en: They were too poor to buy new clothes for winter.
example_uz: Ular qish uchun yangi kiyim sotib olishga juda kambag'al edilar.

definition_en: A country located at the intersection of Eastern Europe and Western Asia.
example_en: Many tourists visit Georgia every year to see the mountains.
example_uz: Har yili ko'plab sayyohlar tog'larni ko'rish uchun Gruziyaga tashrif buyurishadi.

definition_en: A state of quiet and calm without any war or fighting.
example_en: We all want to live in a world of peace.
example_uz: Biz hammamiz tinchlik dunyosida yashashni istaymiz.

definition_en: Following the customs or ways of behaving that have continued for a long time.
example_en: This dance is one of the traditional customs in our local area.
example_uz: Bu raqs hududimizdagi an'anaviy urf-odatlardan biri hisoblanadi.

definition_en: The land and buildings that belong to a college or university.
example_en: The university campus is sixty hectares in size and very green.
example_uz: Universitet shaharchasi oltmish gektar maydonni egallaydi va juda yashil.

definition_en: Having the skill and imagination to produce new and interesting ideas.
example_en: She came up with a creative new solution to the old problem.
example_uz: U eski muammoga ijodiy yangi yechim topdi.

definition_en: The land near or next to the sea or ocean.
example_en: We spent our summer holidays driving along the rocky southern coast.
example_uz: Biz yozgi ta'tilimizni janubiy qoyali qirg'oq bo'ylab sayohat qilib o'tkazdik.

definition_en: The process of getting better at doing something or achieving a goal.
example_en: Science has made extraordinary progress in the last fifty years.
example_uz: Fan oxirgi ellik yil ichida g'oyat katta taraqqiyotga erishdi.

definition_en: Money provided for a particular purpose, especially by a government or organization.
example_en: The council is providing extra funding to repair the school roof.
example_uz: Kengash maktab tomini ta'mirlash uchun qo'shimcha mablag' ajratmoqda.

definition_en: A man who has high rank in a noble class or social system.
example_en: The lord of the manor owned most of the land in the village.
example_uz: Qishloq mulkining lordi qishloqdagi yerlarning ko'p qismiga egalik qilardi.

definition_en: A long sandwich made in a bread roll, or a shortened form of submarine.
example_en: We can stop at the deli to buy some chicken subs.
example_uz: Biz tovuqli sendvichlar sotib olish uchun do'konda to'xtashimiz mumkin.

definition_en: Books and stories about imaginary events and characters instead of real life.
example_en: I prefer reading science fiction because it explores many futuristic ideas.
example_uz: Men ilmiy fantastika o'qishni afzal ko'raman chunki u ko'plab kelajak g'oyalarini o'rganadi.

definition_en: To be aware of sounds using your ears.
example_en: I can hear the sound of the ocean from my hotel room.
example_uz: Men mehmonxona xonamdan okean shovqinini eshita olaman.

definition_en: Further away in the distance than something else.
example_en: The mountain range is located just beyond the small village.
example_uz: Tog' tizmasi kichik qishloqning narigi tarafida joylashgan.

definition_en: The third-person singular present form of the verb to go.
example_en: Every morning he goes to the office by the underground train.
example_uz: Har kuni ertalab u metro poyezdi bilan ofisga boradi.

definition_en: Groups of people consisting of parents and their children living together.
example_en: Many families enjoy spending their weekends in the local park together.
example_uz: Ko'plab oilalar dam olish kunlarini mahalliy bog'da birga o'tkazishdan zavqlanishadi.

definition_en: Used when the people performing an action are also the ones receiving it.
example_en: The children cleaned the messy room all by themselves this morning.
example_uz: Bolalar bugun ertalab tartibsiz xonani o'zlari tozalab qo'yishdi.

definition_en: A machine that moves air to make a room or person feel cooler.
example_en: He didn't switch on the fan because the temperature was 15 degrees Celsius.
example_uz: Harorat 15 daraja bo'lgani uchun u ventilyatorni yoqmadi.

definition_en: To carry or move goods or people from one place to another place.
example_en: The trucks are used to transport fresh fruit to the city markets.
example_uz: Yuk mashinalari yangi mevalarni shahar bozorlariga tashish uchun ishlatiladi.

definition_en: Personal websites where people write about their thoughts or daily life.
example_en: Many travel blogs share useful tips for people visiting new countries.
example_uz: Ko'plab sayohat bloglari yangi mamlakatlarga tashrif buyuruvchilar uchun foydali maslahatlar beradi.

definition_en: The act of judging how good or successful someone or something is.
example_en: The result of the semestral evaluation will go towards your final score.
example_uz: Semestr yakunidagi baholash natijasi yakuniy balingizga ta'sir qiladi.

definition_en: Used to describe someone or something that had a position before now.
example_en: The former president decided to open a school in his hometown.
example_uz: Sobiq prezident o'z ona shahrida maktab ochishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: The process of making a plan or system start to work or be used.
example_en: Now that the requirements are complete we can move on to implementation.
example_uz: Talablar tayyor bo'lganiga ko'ra biz amalga oshirish jarayoniga o'tishimiz mumkin.

definition_en: An area of land or sea that has a special feature or purpose.
example_en: There is a no-smoking zone that extends outside of the building entrance.
example_uz: Binoning kirish qismidan tashqarida chekish taqiqlangan hudud mavjud.

definition_en: Buildings or rooms where paintings and other works of art are shown.
example_en: We spent the whole afternoon looking at paintings in the art galleries.
example_uz: Biz butun tushdan keyin san'at galereyalaridagi suratlarni tomosha qildik.

definition_en: To stop living and lose your life.
example_en: Plants will die if you do not give them enough water.
example_uz: Agar ularga yetarli suv bermasangiz o'simliklar o'lib qoladi.

definition_en: To lift a heavy object, especially a car, using a special tool.
example_en: He had to jack up the car to change the flat tire.
example_uz: U shina almashtirish uchun mashinani domkrat bilan ko'tarishi kerak edi.

definition_en: To move continuously in one direction, like water in a river.
example_en: The river continues to flow steadily through the middle of town.
example_uz: Daryo shahar o'rtasidan barqaror ravishda oqib o'tishda davom etadi.

definition_en: Organizations that provide a particular service on behalf of other businesses.
example_en: Many travel agencies offer cheap holiday packages for families this summer.
example_uz: Ko'plab sayyohlik agentliklari yozda oilalar uchun arzon dam olish paketlarini taklif qiladi.

definition_en: Written works such as books, novels, and poetry considered of high artistic value.
example_en: She enjoys reading classical English literature in her spare time.
example_uz: U bo'sh vaqtida klassik ingliz adabiyotini o'qishdan zavqlanadi.

definition_en: Relating to each of several people or things individually.
example_en: After the meeting, they all returned to their respective offices.
example_uz: Majlisdan so'ng, ularning har biri o'z idorasiga qaytdi.

definition_en: The environment or location where a story or specific event takes place.
example_en: The story has a beautiful setting in a small mountain village.
example_uz: Hikoya tog'li kichik qishloqdagi go'zal muhitda bo'lib o'tadi.

definition_en: The size, extent, or range of something, often used for measurement.
example_en: The project was on a much larger scale than we expected.
example_uz: Loyiha biz kutganimizdan ancha kattaroq miqyosda edi.

definition_en: The most extreme or greatest level, rank, or position.
example_en: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the entire world.
example_uz: Everest cho'qqisi butun dunyodagi eng yuqori tog'dir.

definition_en: Giving or ready to give help; useful or providing assistance.
example_en: The hotel staff were very helpful when we asked for directions.
example_uz: Biz yo'lni so'raganimizda mehmonxona xodimlari juda foydali bo'lishdi.

definition_en: Happening or produced once every month.
example_en: We pay our rent on a monthly basis at the office.
example_uz: Biz ijara haqini ofisda har oyda to'laymiz.

definition_en: Extremely important or necessary for the success of something.
example_en: It is critical that you finish this report before the meeting.
example_uz: Uchrashuvdan oldin ushbu hisobotni tugatishingiz juda muhim.

definition_en: The structure or outer border that supports or encloses something.
example_en: I need to find a nice wooden frame for this photograph.
example_uz: Men ushbu surat uchun chiroyli yog'och ramka topishim kerak.

definition_en: Connected with music or having the qualities of music.
example_en: She has a very musical voice that is pleasant to hear.
example_uz: Uning eshitish uchun yoqimli, juda musiqiy ovozi bor.

definition_en: A statement that explains the meaning of a word or phrase.
example_en: Can you give me a clear definition of this new word?
example_uz: Menga ushbu yangi so'zning aniq ta'rifini bera olasizmi?

definition_en: A person employed in an office to assist with records and communication.
example_en: The secretary scheduled all the meetings for the manager this week.
example_uz: Kotib bu hafta menejer uchun barcha uchrashuvlarni rejalashtirdi.

definition_en: A person who is paid to work for an organization or company.
example_en: The company treats every employee with respect and provides good pay.
example_uz: Kompaniya har bir xodimga hurmat bilan munosabatda bo'ladi va yaxshi maosh to'laydi.

definition_en: Most important or main in rank or purpose.
example_en: The chief reason for our success was hard work and planning.
example_uz: Muvaffaqiyatimizning asosiy sababi mashaqqatli mehnat va rejalashtirish edi.

definition_en: The lowest part of something.
example_en: There was a small coin at the bottom of the fountain.
example_uz: Favvoraning tubida kichik tanga bor edi.

definition_en: A small, specific part of a larger thing or situation.
example_en: Please tell me every detail about your trip to the mountains.
example_uz: Iltimos, tog'larga qilgan sayohatingiz haqidagi har bir tafsilotni aytib bering.

definition_en: An animal kept at home for company and enjoyment.
example_en: My daughter wants a pet cat to keep in our house.
example_uz: Qizim uyimizda saqlash uchun mushukcha istaydi.

definition_en: To start doing something or to come into existence.
example_en: We will begin the meeting as soon as everyone arrives here.
example_uz: Hamma yetib kelishi bilan majlisni boshlaymiz.

definition_en: Relating to a king, queen, or their immediate family members.
example_en: The royal family lives in a large castle in the capital.
example_uz: Qirollik oilasi poytaxtdagi katta qasrda yashaydi.

definition_en: A small device used to turn electrical power on or off.
example_en: You should press the switch to turn on the bedroom light.
example_uz: Yotoqxona chirog'ini yoqish uchun o'chirib-yoqgichni bosishingiz kerak.

definition_en: The object or thing that is the biggest of all others in a group.
example_en: This is the largest city in the country where we live now.
example_uz: Bu biz hozir yashayotgan mamlakatdagi eng katta shahar.

definition_en: Relating to the continent of Africa or its people.
example_en: Many unique animals live in the African savanna during the dry season.
example_uz: Quruq mavsumda Afrika savannasida ko'plab noyob hayvonlar yashaydi.

definition_en: A common informal word for any man or boy.
example_en: That guy is my new friend from the university English class.
example_uz: U yigit universitetdagi ingliz tili darsidan yangi do'stim.

definition_en: A set of rules or instructions that tells you how to do something correctly.
example_en: The teacher provided clear guidelines for the final research paper assignment.
example_uz: O'qituvchi yakuniy ilmiy maqola topshirig'i uchun aniq yo'riqnomalarni taqdim etdi.

definition_en: The quality of being fair and treating people in the correct way.
example_en: Everyone has the right to receive justice in a court of law.
example_uz: Har kim sudda adolat topish huquqiga ega.

definition_en: The holy book of the Christian religion.
example_en: The old family Bible was kept on the highest shelf.
example_uz: Qadimiy oilaviy Injil eng baland tokchada saqlanardi.

definition_en: A container made of thin pieces of wood or wire for carrying things.
example_en: She put all the fresh fruit into the large woven basket.
example_uz: U barcha yangi uzilgan mevalarni katta to'qilgan savatga soldi.

definition_en: Designed to be used in a practical way rather than just for theory.
example_en: The university offers a degree in applied science for modern engineering students.
example_uz: Universitet zamonaviy muhandislik talabalari uchun amaliy fanlar bo‘yicha diplom taklif qiladi.

definition_en: Happening or appearing once every week.
example_en: He goes for his weekly check-up at the hospital every Monday morning.
example_uz: U har dushanba kuni ertalab shifoxonada haftalik tekshiruvdan o‘tadi.

definition_en: The process of putting a piece of equipment or software in place to work.
example_en: The installation of the new software took only a few minutes to finish.
example_uz: Yangi dasturiy ta'minotni o‘rnatish bor-yo‘g‘i bir necha daqiqa vaqt oldi.

definition_en: A set of connected hotel rooms designed for one person or a family.
example_en: The Presidential suite is very large and offers a great city view.
example_uz: Prezident lyuks xonasi juda katta va shaharga ajoyib ko‘rinishni taqdim etadi.

definition_en: A forward movement or an improvement in knowledge or technology.
example_en: Recent medical advances have helped doctors treat serious diseases more effectively today.
example_uz: So‘nggi tibbiy yutuqlar shifokorlarga jiddiy kasalliklarni samaraliroq davolashda yordam berdi.

definition_en: To move forward by jumping lightly from one foot to the other.
example_en: The children love to skip across the playground during their lunch break.
example_uz: Bolalar tushlik paytida o'yin maydonchasi bo'ylab sakrab o'ynashni yaxshi ko'rishadi.

definition_en: A large organized group of people trained to fight on land in a war.
example_en: The army was sent to the border to protect the country's land.
example_uz: Mamlakat hududini himoya qilish uchun armiya chegaraga yuborildi.

definition_en: A public sale where items are sold to the person who offers the most money.
example_en: They decided to sell their old paintings at a public auction last week.
example_uz: Ular o'tgan hafta o'zlarining eski rasmlarini kimoshdi savdosida sotishga qaror qilishdi.

definition_en: The special equipment, clothes, or tools needed for a specific activity or sport.
example_en: Make sure you have all the necessary climbing gear before going up there.
example_uz: U yerga chiqishdan oldin barcha kerakli tog'ga chiqish anjomlaringiz borligiga ishonch hosil qiling.
